description:
Notion's AI chat transcripts were exposed through its AI provider, Fireworks AI, and "zero data retention" turned out to underperform. I also cover Quad9 pulling out of France over site-blocking orders, 333 hijacked Tor exit nodes targeting SSH and email, the Proton AI controversy, and then the secret court ruling on how the US spies on Americans. Plus our normal data breaches, threats, and open source updates. Thanks for the patience everyone!
